name: code-memory-visualizer
description: Educational VS Code extension prototype for stepping through Python and Java code while visualizing memory state.

codeMemory.pythonPath.description: Python command used by Code Memory. Examples: python, python3, py -3.

codeMemory.javaPath.description: Java command used by Code Memory. It must come from a JDK with the jdk.jdi module.

codeMemory.javacPath.description: Java compiler command used by Code Memory. It must come from a JDK.
